on GetUserAccount
	put cdb_readUserAccount(emailTemp, passwordTemp ,true) into authedUserRecord
	if authedUserRecord is "false" then 
		answer "User Account Not Loaded"
	else
		put the keys of authedUserRecord into authedUserID 
		//EMPTY VARIABLES
		delete variable authedUserRecord["cdb"]
		put authedUserRecord[authedUserID ] into authedUserRecord
		put empty into passwordTemp
		put empty into emailTemp 
	end if 
end GetUserAccount
